# Q-Link v3.0 - Platform & Feature Knowledge

> Q-Link is a next-generation real-time quantum communication and messaging platform designed for privacy, speed, and sleek modern aesthetics across Web, Mobile PWA, and Windows Desktop.

## Core & Micro-Features Overview (Non-Technical Summary)

### 1. Smart Conversation & Interaction Ranking
- **Dynamic Activity Sorting**: Active chats and newly messaged friends automatically bubble to the very top of your conversation list in real-time.
- **Unread Message Priority**: Contacts with new incoming messages receive glowing highlight badges and move up for immediate visibility.
- **Automated Inactive Tiering**: Unused or inactive contacts naturally rest at the bottom of the list without cluttering active conversations.

### 2. Real-Time Message Status & Indicators
- **Instant Status Ticks**: Clear WhatsApp-style indicators:
  - Single Grey Tick: Message sent to the server.
  - Double Grey Tick: Message delivered to the recipient's active device.
  - Double Glowing Green Tick: Message opened and seen by the recipient in active chat.
- **Live Typing Waveform**: Real-time visual animated waves appear when your contact is composing a reply.
- **Live Online Presence Dots**: Subtle glowing indicators show when contacts are currently active.

### 3. Privacy & Self-Cleaning Media
- **24-Hour Ephemeral Media**: Shared photos, videos, and media files automatically clean up and expire after 24 hours to keep devices fast and protect conversation privacy.
- **Client-Side Data Protection**: Private direct messaging designed for peace of mind.

### 4. Q-BEACON Priority Emergency Alert Protocol
- **Instant Urgent Flash**: A dedicated high-priority alert system for important or urgent communication.
- **Audible Emergency Chime & Full-Screen Elevation**: Triggers high-priority audible chimes and full-screen notification banners on receiving devices.
- **One-Tap Instant Acknowledgement**: Allows recipients to acknowledge or reply with quick status updates.

### 5. Smart Chat Scroll & Ergonomics
- **Active Scroll Position Memory**: Prevents annoying auto-scrolling when you are reading older messages.
- **Smart Auto-Snap**: Automatically smoothly snaps to the newest message when you send a message or receive a message while at the bottom.

### 6. Voice Memos & Rich Media
- **One-Tap Voice Recording**: Record and send crystal-clear audio voice messages.
- **Interactive Audio Wave Player**: Visual playback progress with custom audio controls.
- **Social Feed & Post Layouts**: Post updates with formatted mentions (`@username`), hashtags (`#topic`), and automatic link detection.

### 7. VIP & Founder Showcase Experience
- **Dynamic Visual Badges**: Collect and display custom profile badges and verified identity tiers.
- **Diamond & Sapphire VIP Cards**: Interactive digital profile cards with animated metallic sheens, glowing borders, and smooth video canvases.
- **Quantum Points (QP) & Founder Rewards**: Reward system for community engagement and VIP tier holders.

### 8. Cross-Platform Standalone Desktop App (.exe)
- **Windows Tray Background Mode**: Closes smoothly to the Windows System Tray so you never miss incoming messages while working.
- **Zero-Flicker Notification Badges**: Native desktop taskbar and notification count indicators.
- **Auto-Launch & Fast Focus**: Launch from Desktop shortcut, Start Menu, or Taskbar with instant window restoration.

### 9. Hardware & GPU Performance Modes
- **Ultra High Performance Tier**: 60fps glassmorphism effects, rich backdrop blurs, and dynamic glow lighting.
- **Battery Saver / Low-Power Tier**: Optimizes rendering for laptops and low-battery devices.

### 10. Intelligent AI Assistant Companion
- **Smart Help Banner & Ambient Trigger**: Quick access to guided help with gentle, non-intrusive appearance and dismissal controls.
